commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+1' The resulting set piece from Las Palmas is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+1' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Las Palmas have been awarded a corner kick.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
90' Marvin (Las Palmas) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Las Palmas earn a corner.
88' The corner from Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) is intercepted by the defence.
88' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall. The ball goes out of play. Las Palmas are awarded a corner kick.
87' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) and blew his whistle. It's a free kick to Las Palmas in a dangerous position.
83' 2 - 3 Goal! Alex Munoz (Las Palmas) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Kirian Rodriguez and easily beat the keeper with a header into the middle of the goal from close range. 2:3.
83' The corner is swung in but Las Palmas can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

82' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Las Palmas have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

82' Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the right post. Julen Agirrezabala guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
81' Las Palmas take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
77' Luis Carrion has decided to make a change. Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) replaces Oliver McBurnie.
77' Here is a change. Scott McKenna is going off and Luis Carrion gives the last tactical orders to Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas).
77' Here comes a substitution. Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) is brought on as a substitute for Oscar de Marcos.
76' 1 - 3 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Inaki Williams finds Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:3.
75' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
75' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. It will be a corner kick for Ath Bilbao.
71' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to substitute Nico Williams and he is replaced by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao).
71' Oihan Sancet comes off the pitch to be replaced by Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao).
70' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

70' Julen Agirrezabala pulls off a fantastic save! Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the top of the net, but the effort is kept out. The linesman makes the right call and Las Palmas will have a corner.
64' That was close by Fabio Gonzalez (Las Palmas)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
63' A substitution has been made. Javier Munoz is replaced by Fabio Silva (Las Palmas).

63' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) latches on to a fine cross from the resulting corner and attempts to finish from the edge of the box. His shot, however, misses the target narrowly wide of the left post.
63' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
62' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Now Ath Bilbao have a corner.
59' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor decides to make a substitution. Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta will be replaced by Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao).
59' The substitution is prepared. Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Gorka Guruzeta.
58' 1 - 2 Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) takes a wonderful free kick and curls the ball into the top left corner with an absolutely phenomenal strike!
56' That was really pointless! Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) made a mindless challenge and the referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias showed him a red card.
52' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
50' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
49' The attendance is 25908.
46' Half-time substitution. Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) is replaced by Alex Munoz.
46' Half-time substitution. Jose Campana (Las Palmas) will not participate anymore and Fabio Gonzalez is coming on.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' Jose Campana (Las Palmas) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
45+3' An attempted cross from Marvin (Las Palmas) is cleared. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Las Palmas will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45+2' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias shows the yellow card to Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) for a heavy challenge.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
40' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) works the corner short.
40' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Las Palmas have been awarded a corner kick.

38' What a chance! Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and takes a shot to the bottom right corner, but one of the defending players makes a crucial goal-line clearance.
33' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
33' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Good work from Ath Bilbao as they win a corner.

30' 0 - 2 Inaki Williams produces a sweet pass and picks out Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the bottom right corner and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 0:2!
29' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
27' Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
24' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
22' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias shows a yellow card to Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) for a tough tackle.
18' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal.
15' A pass from Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is intercepted by Jasper Cillessen and the move breaks down.
12' Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) is able to continue to play.
10' Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.

8' 0 - 1 Goal! Inaki Williams plays in Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom right corner 0:1.

6' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Julen Agirrezabala thwarts him with a great two-handed save.

5' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) beats a couple of players and hammers in a low shot from mid-range towards the middle of the goal. The keeper is caught unaware but still pulls off a great save to deny the effort.
